sloka: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते ।उत्तिष्ठ नर शार्दूल कर्तव्यम् दैवमाह्निकम् ॥१-२३-२॥
transliteration: kausalyā suprajā rāma pūrvā saṁdhyā pravartate ।uttiṣṭha nara śārdūla kartavyam daivamāhnikam ॥1-23-2॥

translations.english: "O beloved son of Kausalya, O Rama the day dawns. O best among men, awake, oblations to gods and other sacred rites are required to be performed".
